Container.Name: stintara
Container.Overview: Stintara is a simulator-independent live timing and race-intelligence platform. V0.1 ingests LMU Pitwall telemetry through the Stintara agent and stores live scoring, laps and strategy telemetry in PostgreSQL.
Container.Requires: Requires the stintara-postgres container and the custom Docker network: docker network create stintara

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Host port for the Stintara Web UI and agent API.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent application data reserved for imports and future local artifacts.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_HOST
Config.Description: Docker DNS name of the Stintara PostgreSQL container.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PORT
Config.Description: Internal PostgreSQL port. Do not publish this port on Unraid.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional full PostgreSQL DSN. Leave blank to use the POSTGRES_* fields above. If set, it overrides them.

Config.Name: Driver name
Config.Description: Initial Stintara driver display name for this V0.1 agent.

Config.Name: Agent name
Config.Description: Friendly name of the first LMU telemetry agent.

Config.Name: Agent token
Config.Description: Set a long random token. Configure exactly the same token on the Windows Stintara agent.
